[Council File 24-0196-S1]
Motion (McOsker – Nazarian) relative to releasing reports for policy options and code amendments to streamline matters related to the administration, enforcement, governance, implementation, and oversight of nuisance abatement proceedings as previously requested in Council File 24-0196.
(This item was referred to the Public Works Committee and Planning and Land Use Management Committee)

None submitted
